title: Noetherian topology of a Noetherian algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Assume $X$ is quasi-compact and locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Here quasi-compact means that every open cover has a finite subcover. Then the atlas point space $|X|$ [def-a1-space-point-topology] is Noetherian: every nonempty family of closed subsets has a member minimal under inclusion.

source.place: Tag 04ZF, lemma-Noetherian-topology, clause (2); Noetherianity expressed as well-founded strict inclusion on closed subsets.

proof.text: By [lem-a1-space-affine-etale-cover], the quotient topology of a representable surjective etale scheme atlas of $X$ makes $|t|$ continuous for every representable etale $t:h_T\to X$ from a scheme; hence it coincides with the final topology of [def-a1-space-point-topology], and the quasi-compactness hypothesis on $|X|$ is that of [lem-sfb-qc-space-affine-etale-atlas]. By [lem-sfb-qc-space-affine-etale-atlas], quasi-compactness of $|X|$ gives an affine scheme $W$ and a representable surjective etale morphism $p:h_W\to X$. By [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus], its point map $q=|p|:|W|\to|X|$ is continuous and surjective.

source.place: Tag 03H6, lemma-quasi-compact-affine-cover; Tag 03H5, lemma-characterize-surjective; Tag 03BX, lemma-topology-points; Tag 04ZF, lemma-Noetherian-topology, choice of etale presentation.

proof.text: The hypothesis that $X$ is locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts applies to $p$, so $W$ is locally Noetherian. Since $W$ is affine, [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs] says that it is quasi-compact. Thus $W$ is a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact); no quasi-separatedness assumption on $X$ has been used.

source.place: Tag 04ZF, lemma-Noetherian-topology, proof: the etale chart is locally Noetherian; Tag 03H6, lemma-quasi-compact-affine-cover; affine quasi-compactness is algebra.tex Tag 00E8, lemma-quasi-compact.

proof.text: Let $\mathcal C$ be any nonempty family of closed subsets of $|X|$. Continuity of $q$ makes $\mathcal D=\{q^{-1}(C):C\in\mathcal C\}$ a nonempty family of closed subsets of $|W|$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal] to the Noetherian scheme $W$ and $\mathcal D$. Choose $C_0\in\mathcal C$ whose inverse image is a minimal member of $\mathcal D$.

source.place: Tag 01OZ, lemma-Noetherian-topology; minimal-closed-subset form of Noetherianity. The inverse-image argument follows topology.tex Tag 04Z8, lemma-image-Noetherian, proof of (1).

proof.text: If $C\in\mathcal C$ satisfied $C\subsetneq C_0$, then $q^{-1}(C)\subseteq q^{-1}(C_0)$. Choose $x\in C_0\setminus C$ and, by surjectivity of $q$, $w\in|W|$ with $q(w)=x$. Then $w\in q^{-1}(C_0)\setminus q^{-1}(C)$, so the inclusion is strict, contradicting minimality. Hence $C_0$ is minimal in $\mathcal C$, as required. This includes $X=\varnothing$, where the only closed subset is $\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 04Z8, lemma-image-Noetherian, proof of (1), written for minimal members rather than descending sequences.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04ZF, lemma-Noetherian-topology, (2), using the affine etale presentation of Tag 03H6 and the elementary inverse-image proof of topology.tex Tag 04Z8 (lemma-image-Noetherian, (1)).
